resolved_prior_blockers: external setsid supervisor is required and start verifies session and process group
TERM INT and HUP share owned cleanup
stop waits for process resources shared lock and active record release
tracked untracked and ignored worktree content is rejected
smoke binds active record identity mode commit argv host log and approval
maintenance-exclusive cold smoke checks empty preceding prefill and exact log rows/token totals
remaining_boundary: Actual detach lifecycle lock port release and cold smoke are deployment-only evidence. Backend logs lack request IDs, so the documented maintenance-exclusive boundary is required for cold attribution.
